objective.statement: Cancel a sharp or flat with a natural, and follow an accidental through a tie.
successCriteria: I know a natural sign cancels an accidental for the rest of the bar.
I know a tied note keeps its accidental across the bar-line.
I can read a short passage with several accidentals.

explanation.text: A natural sign (♮) cancels a sharp or flat. Notes after it on that line or space are plain until the end of the bar.

music.textAlternative: A bar of 4/4: F sharp, then F with a natural sign, then G, then F. The last F is plain too.

explanation.caption: The natural sign cancels the F sharp. The last F is plain: the natural lasts to the end of the bar.

explanation.text: A tie joins two notes of the same pitch. If the tie crosses a bar-line, the second note keeps the accidental of the first, even though it is in a new bar.

music.textAlternative: Two bars of 4/4. Bar 1 ends on an F sharp. Bar 2 starts on an F with no sign. The F in bar 2 is plain.

explanation.caption: Without a tie, the F in bar 2 is plain. With a tie from the F sharp, it would still be F sharp.

explanation.text: Only the first note after a tie across a bar-line inherits the accidental. After that the new bar starts afresh.

music.textAlternative: A bar of 4/4: F sharp, F natural, G, F.

steps: Tap the F sharp, then the next F. It is lower: the natural has cancelled the sharp.
Tap the last F. It is plain too, because the natural lasts to the end of the bar.
A natural sign is how you undo a sharp or flat without starting a new bar.
demonstration.textAlternative: A bar with an F sharp, a natural-cancelled F, a G and a plain F.

mistakes.accidental-forgotten: An accidental keeps working for the rest of the bar on that line or space.
mistakes.accidental-carried-over-barline: A bar-line cancels accidentals — unless the note is tied across it.
mistakes.key-signature-ignored: Don't forget the key signature: it affects every note with that letter name.
mistakes.different-octave-assumed: An accidental only affects notes on the same line or space — not the same letter in another octave.
mistakes.tie-over-barline: A tie carries the accidental into the next bar, but only for the tied note.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Go through the bar from the start, tracking each accidental.
